meta.title: 自由泳移肩练习｜告别僵硬划手
meta.title_en: Freestyle Shoulder-Shift Drill | Say Goodbye to a Stiff Pull

scenes.context: 陆上移肩练习的站立起始姿势，双臂前伸准备肩胛骨运动。语域：游泳教学，陆上练习。
sentences: 陆上移肩练习的起始姿势。
The standing start of the on-land shoulder-shift drill.
Extend the arms forward, ready to go.
Get the scapulae ready to move.
paraphrase: 移肩 → shoulder-shift / move the shoulder
scenes.speak: The standing start of the on-land shoulder-shift drill. Extend the arms forward, ready to go. Get the scapulae ready to move.

scenes.context: 肩胛骨向前送出：手臂保持不动，仅用肩胛骨带动肩膀前移。语域：游泳教学，发力要领。
sentences: keep the arm still（手臂不动）
Let the scapula alone drive the shoulder.
paraphrase: 送出 → push forward / drive out
带动 → drive / lead the motion
scenes.speak: Push the scapula forward. Keep the arm still. Let the scapula alone drive the shoulder.

scenes.context: 肩胛骨后缩回位，完成一个完整的移肩周期。前后两个方向都要练。语域：游泳教学，完整周期。
sentences: The scapula retracts back into place.
完成一个完整的移肩周期。
That completes one full shoulder-shift cycle.
Train both directions, forward and back.
paraphrase: 完整周期 → a full cycle / the complete motion
scenes.speak: The scapula retracts back into place. That completes one full shoulder-shift cycle. Train both directions, forward and back.

scenes.context: 肩部回到自然位置，动作循环结束。重复练习，告别僵硬划手。语域：游泳教学，收尾。
sentences: The shoulder returns to its neutral position.
the move cycle closes（循环结束）
Practice more and say goodbye to a stiff pull.
paraphrase: 自然位置 → neutral position / the resting point
僵硬划手 → stiff pull / a rigid stroke
scenes.speak: The shoulder returns to its neutral position. The move cycle closes. Practice more and say goodbye to a stiff pull.

practice: Extend the arms forward, ready to go.
Let the scapula alone drive the shoulder.
The scapula retracts back into place.
Practice more and say goodbye to a stiff pull.
pitfalls: 「手臂保持不动」用 keep the arm still，只动肩胛骨。
The scapula retracts back into place.
Train both directions, forward and back.
「两个方向都要练」用 both directions。
Practice more and say goodbye to a stiff pull.
shifts: 用 freestyle pull（自由泳划手）、stiff pull（僵硬划手）、shoulder-shift drill（移肩练习）
用 scapula（肩胛骨）、shoulder blades（肩胛骨）、drive the shoulder（带动肩膀）
用 drill（练习）、a full cycle（完整周期）、both directions（两个方向）
